name: anyscore
description: Canadian immigration points grids: Express Entry and provincial scoring. Deterministic grid_assessment only — never eligibility.

interface.longDescription: Deterministic scoring of official Canadian immigration points grids. The engine converts declared policy-grid factors into a source-cited grid_assessment. It does not infer CLB, age, experience, or education, and it never outputs eligible or qualified. Zero backend AI cost; the host agent derives factors from evidence.
defaultPrompt: List the live Canadian immigration points grids.
Evaluate this profile against Express Entry CRS.
What-if: if language scores change, how do the grid points change?
